name: Chalet Belmonte
beschreibung: The Chalet Belmonte is situated in a quiet side location in the Tiroler Alpen. The surroundings are characterized by forests and mountain meadows that invite you to take walks. The holiday home has a fully equipped kitchen and a living area with fireplace. The chalet accommodates up to eight people in four bedrooms. The atmosphere in the house is quiet and relaxing. The accommodation is suitable for families or groups looking for a quiet holiday.
